actions.value:
set +e
date -u +%FT%T.%N
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 56s /bin/sh <<'ZOOM_UI_OBSERVATION_SOURCE'
PHASE=before-launch
# Read-only guest observation source; PHASE is supplied by the JSON assembler.
. /home/probe/session-env
set -u
failures=0
observe() {
  label=$1
  shift
  printf '\nZOOM_UI_OBSERVATION_START=%s\n' "$label"
  date -u +%FT%T.%N
  timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 4s "$@"
  rc=$?
  printf 'ZOOM_UI_OBSERVATION_EXIT=%s:%s\n' "$label" "$rc"
  if test "$rc" -ne 0; then failures=$((failures + 1)); fi
}
printf 'ZOOM_UI_PHASE=%s\n' "$PHASE"
printf 'EXPECTED_ORIGINAL_APP_COMMIT=df68d5e6649a894643f4bff68711e52ad86c2f26c93470139f2ff1e2b38e4418\n'
observe uptime cat /proc/uptime
observe shell-stat cat /proc/34063/stat
observe shell-exe readlink /proc/34063/exe
observe display-owner gdbus call --session --dest org.freedesktop.DBus --object-path /org/freedesktop/DBus --method org.freedesktop.DBus.GetNameOwner org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig
observe shell-owner gdbus call --session --dest org.freedesktop.DBus --object-path /org/freedesktop/DBus --method org.freedesktop.DBus.GetNameOwner org.gnome.Shell
observe display-state gdbus call --session --dest org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig --object-path /org/gnome/Mutter/DisplayConfig --method org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig.GetCurrentState
observe geometry /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/snapshot-guest.py
if test "$PHASE" = before-launch; then
  observe magnifier-binding gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys magnifier
  observe application-settings gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications
  observe magnifier-settings gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.desktop.a11y.magnifier
  # Raw user override, including an absent value, is distinct from effective.
  observe zoom-user-value dconf read /org/gnome/desktop/a11y/applications/screen-magnifier-enabled
  observe zoom-writable gsettings writable org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled
  observe installed-commit flatpak info --show-commit org.localsend.localsend_app
  observe installed-runtime flatpak info --show-runtime org.localsend.localsend_app
  observe installed-metadata flatpak info --show-metadata org.localsend.localsend_app
fi
printf '\nZOOM_UI_FLATPAK_INSTANCES_START\n'
instances=$(timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 4s flatpak ps --columns=instance,pid,child-pid,application,arch,branch,commit,runtime,runtime-branch,runtime-commit)
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$instances"
printf 'ZOOM_UI_FLATPAK_INSTANCES_EXIT=%s\n' "$rc"
if test "$rc" -ne 0; then failures=$((failures + 1)); fi
observe process-tree ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,comm,args
if test "$PHASE" = after-launch; then
  # Wrapper and sandbox child are observations, not the app PID. Also retain
  # executable-name candidates; join them to fresh raw tree/maps/geometry.
  candidates=$( { printf '%s\n' "$instances" | awk '$4 == "org.localsend.localsend_app" {print $2; print $3}'; pgrep -x localsend_app; pgrep -x localsend; } | awk '/^[0-9]+$/ && $0 > 0 && !seen[$0]++ {print}' )
  count=0
  for pid in $candidates; do
    count=$((count + 1))
    if test "$count" -gt 8; then
      printf 'ZOOM_UI_PROCESS_CANDIDATES_TRUNCATED\n'
      failures=$((failures + 1))
      break
    fi
    printf '\nZOOM_UI_PROCESS_CANDIDATE=%s\n' "$pid"
    observe "pid-$pid-stat-before" cat "/proc/$pid/stat"
    observe "pid-$pid-status" cat "/proc/$pid/status"
    observe "pid-$pid-exe" readlink "/proc/$pid/exe"
    observe "pid-$pid-exe-hash" sha256sum "/proc/$pid/exe"
    observe "pid-$pid-cmdline" sh -c 'tr "\000" "\n" < "$1"' sh "/proc/$pid/cmdline"
    observe "pid-$pid-maps" cat "/proc/$pid/maps"
    # A wrapper/host candidate can lack this sandbox metadata. Preserve that
    # exit separately without requiring every candidate to be the actual app.
    # Root joins the actual executable candidate to full commit/instance fields.
    printf 'ZOOM_UI_CANDIDATE_FLATPAK_INFO_START=%s\n' "$pid"
    timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 4s cat "/proc/$pid/root/.flatpak-info"
    metadata_rc=$?
    printf 'ZOOM_UI_CANDIDATE_FLATPAK_INFO_EXIT=%s:%s\n' "$pid" "$metadata_rc"
    if test "$metadata_rc" -ne 0; then
      printf 'ZOOM_UI_CANDIDATE_FLATPAK_INFO_UNAVAILABLE=%s:wrapper-or-unresolved-app-candidate\n' "$pid"
    fi
    observe "pid-$pid-stat-after" cat "/proc/$pid/stat"
  done
  if test "$count" -eq 0; then
    printf 'ZOOM_UI_NO_LIVE_LOCALSEND_CANDIDATE\n'
    failures=$((failures + 1))
  fi
  observe launch-log cat /home/probe/evidence/localsend.log
fi
observe editor-stat cat /proc/34918/stat
observe editor-exe readlink /proc/34918/exe
observe calculator-stat cat /proc/34825/stat
observe calculator-exe readlink /proc/34825/exe
printf 'ZOOM_UI_PHASE_COMPLETE=%s:failures=%s\n' "$PHASE" "$failures"
test "$failures" -eq 0
ZOOM_UI_OBSERVATION_SOURCE
rc=$?
printf 'ZOOM_UI_WHOLE_PROBE_EXIT=before-launch:%s
' "$rc"
date -u +%FT%T.%N
exit "$rc"
